archival_memory.espresso_machine_order_tracking: Real-time tracking is available after shipment. You’ll receive an email with a tracking number and a link to the carrier’s website. Updates include: departure from warehouse, transit status, and estimated delivery. For Seattle customers, we recommend checking tracking every 12–24 hours during rainy weather to ensure safe delivery.
archival_memory.espresso_machine_return_policy: 30-day return window for defective items or incorrect size. Free return shipping for all returns. Items must be in original condition with all packaging and accessories. Exchanges are free and no restocking fee. Customer service handles returns and provides tracking for the return shipment.
